name: tidyVOD
description: Rename, combine, and export curated VOD categories in one plugin.
author: ayala

fields.label: Category editor
fields.value: Enter a clean name beside any provider category, or use Hide this category to stop importing it and remove its existing VOD. Hidden categories remain here so they can be restored.

fields.label: Limit to provider accounts
fields.help_text: Optional comma-separated Dispatcharr M3U account names. Blank means all active accounts.

fields.label: TMDB Clean-up
fields.value: Enable TMDB Clean-up beneath only the categories you want managed. Category prefixes select localized titles and posters; uncertain matches are left unchanged.

fields.label: TMDB API key
fields.help_text: Optional when TMDB_API_KEY is already configured for Dispatcharr.

fields.label: Keep language prefix in cleaned titles
fields.help_text: Recommended. Produces titles such as ES| Die Hard (1989).

fields.label: Player-safe TMDB titles
fields.help_text: Recommended. Uses a language prefix such as ES - and substitutes visually equivalent brackets that IPTV apps do not hide; for example [REC]² becomes ES - ［REC］² (2009).

fields.label: Language prefix mappings
fields.default: EN=en, ES=es, FR=fr, IT=it, DE=de, PT=pt, PL=pl, TR=tr, AR=ar, JA=ja, KO=ko

fields.label: Remove these provider title tags
fields.default: 4K, UHD, HDR, HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, DV, 2160p, 1080p, 720p, FHD, HEVC, H.265, H265, x265, AV1, BluRay, Blu-ray, WEB-DL, WEBRip, BDRip, REMUX, Dolby Atmos, Atmos, DDP5.1, AAC
fields.help_text: Comma-separated and editable. Used only for safe matching; final names come from confirmed TMDB records.

fields.label: Remove leading release labels
fields.default: SD/CAM, CAM, HDCAM, HD-CAM, HDTS, HD-TS, TS, TELESYNC, TC, SCR, SCREENER
fields.help_text: Comma-separated and editable. Removed only at the beginning of a provider title when followed by a separator, such as SD/CAM – Moana (2026).

fields.label: Advanced rules (optional)
fields.value: Regex rules are available for bulk patterns and title cleanup.

fields.label: Advanced category rules (JSON)
fields.help_text: Ordered regex rules with pattern, target, and optional content_type.

fields.label: Title cleanup rules (JSON)
fields.help_text: Ordered regex rules with pattern, replacement, and optional content_type.

fields.label: Portable category-name backup (JSON)
fields.help_text: Back up mappings fills this after a page reload. Copy it locally, or paste a saved backup and use Import pasted backup.

fields.label: M3U export
fields.value: Export your curated categories into tidy m3u/xmltv files for tools like m3u4u.

fields.label: Output directory
fields.help_text: Directory where playlist files are written. One stable name plus timestamped backups are created.

fields.label: Export after synchronized changes
fields.help_text: When synchronization moves new VOD items, refresh the stable M3U/XMLTV export too.

fields.label: Keep curated categories synchronized
fields.help_text: Automatically starts with Dispatcharr. Every minute, repair mapped category assignments for new and previously curated movies and series.

actions.label: Back up category names
actions.description: Save a durable snapshot of every clean name you entered.

actions.label: Restore category names
actions.description: Restore the latest saved clean-name snapshot into the category editor.

confirm.title: Restore saved category names?
confirm.message: Current clean-name fields will be backed up first, then replaced by the latest saved snapshot.

actions.label: Import portable category-name backup
actions.description: Restore clean-name fields from JSON pasted into the portable backup field.

confirm.title: Import pasted category names?
confirm.message: Current clean-name fields will be backed up first, then replaced by the pasted snapshot.

actions.label: Preview changes
actions.description: Count and sample changes without writing to the database.

actions.label: Apply changes
actions.description: Apply configured category, hiding, and title rules.

confirm.title: Apply VOD changes?
confirm.message: A backup is saved first. Hidden categories will be disabled and their existing provider assignments removed.

actions.label: Restore plugin changes
actions.description: Restore category and title values saved by this plugin.

confirm.title: Restore VOD values?
confirm.message: This only restores values tracked by tidyVOD and earlier compatible builds.

actions.label: Preview export
actions.description: Compute counts for the current settings without writing files.

actions.label: Export playlist
actions.description: Write M3U (+ optional XMLTV) files to disk.

confirm.title: Export curated playlist?
confirm.message: This writes/overwrites the stable output files and creates a timestamped snapshot.

actions.label: Repair curated categories now
actions.description: Check new and previously curated VOD and repair category assignments using your saved mappings.

actions.label: Run selected TMDB clean-up now
actions.description: Clean titles and posters in categories whose TMDB Clean-up switch is enabled.

actions.label: TMDB clean-up report
actions.description: Show cleaned titles and detect poster assignments that need repair.

actions.label: Synchronization status
actions.description: Check watcher health, including disabled, stale, or failed synchronization, and the last result.

actions.label: Watch for VOD after M3U refresh
actions.description: Internal event notice; continuous synchronization waits for the separate VOD import.
